name: Vardhman Special Steels Ltd
title: Vardhman Special Steels Ltd - 534392 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Management guides FY27 EBITDA/ton to INR8,000–11,000 (up from 7,000–10,000) and rolled volume to ~250,000 t on a 270,000 t rolling capacity after reheating furnace commissioning; capex to ~INR2,600 cr committed through FY30.

utilisation.quote: our rolling mill capacity is close to 180,000 tons. And we have done a lot of outsourced rolling and therefore, we managed to sell 225,000 tons.

capex.quote: the committed investment is about INR2,600 crores

triggers.label: Committed capex ~INR2,600 cr through FY30
triggers.quote: as of now, the committed investment is about INR2,600 crores

triggers.label: EBITDA/t guide raised to 8,000–11,000
triggers.quote: this year, our guidance is now up from last year, which is INR8,000 to INR11,000 a ton EBITDA

triggers.label: Price increase sought from Q1
triggers.quote: we are asking for a price increase from Q1, and we are likely to get those price increases in Q1

triggers.label: Record volume 225,000 t; FY27 target ~250k
triggers.quote: Volume has been the highest, 225,000 tons, which was our budget.

guidance.quote: this year, our guidance is now up from last year, which is INR8,000 to INR11,000 a ton EBITDA
from 2 years from now, I think we are confident now that this range can be increased further to 9,000 to 12,000
it will be close to INR12 crores to INR13 crores for both the incentives
we will keep it below 0.75 total debt to equity. And we are comfortable at 0.5
We seem to be on track that we will start our plant in July 2029 as of now.
And Jan-March of '28, we hope to start the production from the forging line.
